description.value: John 3:16 Malaysian Delights is a Malaysian restaurant chain founded in Richmond in 2014, with the Burnaby outpost on the busy Kingsway corridor offering authentic Malaysian rice dishes, noodles, and hot beverages. The restaurant prides itself on chefs skilled in traditional Malaysian cooking and serves a broad menu from appetizers to desserts. With online ordering and a takeout-friendly format, it makes a practical meal stop on a Kingsway cycling route.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 8m; stands at 100m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Burnaby location at 5152 Kingsway with phone 604-566-1122 matching OSM exactly. Online ordering is prominently linked on the Burnaby menu page, confirming takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the About Us page mentions ample parking only for the Richmond flagship location.
concerns: OSM name 'John 3:16 Malaysian Delights' differs from website branding 'John 316 Malaysian Delight' (colon omitted, no trailing 's') — minor but worth reconciling
OSM old_name tag 'SOJU' indicates a prior business at this address; listing should be monitored for any signage or identity confusion

Burnaby hours are inconsistent between subpages: /burnaby-menu/ shows Mon–Sat lunch/dinner split with Sunday closed, while /burnaby-location/ shows Sat–Thu 11am–7pm and Fri 11am–8pm — one page is likely outdated
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed-open restaurant on a major cycling corridor with no required cycling criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) verifiable from the website; on-site visit needed to confirm at least bike parking or visibility before listing.
